fusions.name: Reeking Display
fusions.desc: Puffs up and stamps around in a musky display, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Musk-Smeared Slap
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up. Slaps it with a musk-smeared palm for 8 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristled Warning
fusions.desc: Bristles and reeks: for 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Once Bitten
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to its source instead.
